summary: @ornikar/eslint-plugin-ornikar preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated 727 KB bundle
details: The package's package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs is obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style _0xNNNNNN identifiers with string-array indirection) and, on install, downloads the Bun runtime binary v1.3.13 from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, chmods it executable, and invokes it to run the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727 KB single-line Bun-CJS bundle beginning with a shuffled string/numeric constant array and a rotator function (WV8StW) shifting that array — a classic string-array obfuscation pattern that cannot be audited by Node-based tooling. The package is advertised as an ESLint plugin, a role that has no need for the Bun runtime or a large opaque bundled payload. Installing the package therefore causes an alternate-runtime dropper to fetch a runtime and execute attacker-supplied bytes on the installer's machine at npm install time. The obfuscation of both the wrapper and the payload, together with the runtime mismatch against the package's declared purpose, contradicts a benign build-tool explanation.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
